title: Compositional Loop Invariant Inference for Multiphase Programs via Structured Neurosymbolic Reasoning
title_zh: 基于结构化神经符号推理的多阶段程序组合式循环不变量推断

paragraphs.en: CLOVER框架通过组合式推断与反例引导精炼，显著提升多阶段程序循环不变量推断效果。 Loop invariants are essential for deductive program verification, yet automatically inferring them for {multiphase programs}, whose loops contain conditional branches that induce multiple execution phases with distinct behaviors, remains an open problem. Existing LLM-based methods either reason about loops as a whole or use explicit branch information to generate atomic assertions jointly across branches, without maintaining complete candidate sub-invariants for independent generation and targeted repair. We present CLOVER, a structured neurosymbolic reasoning framework for multiphase invariant inference built on two interlinked mechanisms. First, compositional inference: CLOVER statically decomposes a loop into symbolic {loop branch sequences}, conjunctions of the loop guard and branch conditions that characterize distinct execution scenarios, and guides the LLM to generate candidate sub-invariants for each one independently, so that each LLM query focuses on a single execution scenario rather than the entire loop. Second, counterexample-guided localized refinement: when SMT verification rejects a composed disjunctive invariant, CLOVER traces the counterexample back through the branch structure to identify which specific loop branch sequence caused the failure and repairs only that sub-invariant, preserving all correct components. Both mechanisms are unified by a shared symbolic structure derived from the loop's branch semantics, which guides what the LLM generates, how candidates are composed, and where refinement is directed. We evaluate CLOVER on 316 linear arithmetic, 50 nonlinear arithmetic, and 54 multiphase benchmarks. CLOVER solves 35 of 54 multiphase benchmarks, outperforming the best LLM-based baseline (29) by 20.7\% and the best traditional method (22) by 59.1\%. On linear/nonlinear benchmarks, CLOVER remains competitive, solving 355 of 366 programs overall.
paragraphs.zh: CLOVER框架通过组合式推断与反例引导精炼，显著提升多阶段程序循环不变量推断效果。循环不变量对演绎程序验证至关重要，然而为{多阶段程序}自动推断循环不变量仍是一个悬而未决的问题，这类程序的循环包含条件分支，会引发具有不同行为的多个执行阶段。 现有基于LLM的方法要么将循环作为一个整体进行推理，要么利用显式分支信息在各分支上联合生成原子断言，而没有维护完整的候选子不变量以供独立生成和针对性修复。 我们提出CLOVER，一个用于多阶段不变量推断的结构化神经符号推理框架，它建立在两个相互关联的机制之上。 第一，组合式推断：CLOVER静态地将循环分解为符号化的{循环分支序列}，即刻画不同执行场景的循环守护条件与分支条件的合取，并引导LLM为每个场景独立生成候选子不变量，使每次LLM查询聚焦于单一执行场景而非整个循环。 第二，反例引导的局部化精炼：当SMT验证拒绝某个组合后的析取不变量时，CLOVER通过分支结构追溯反例，识别出是哪个具体的循环分支序列导致了失败，并只修复该子不变量，同时保留所有正确的组成部分。 这两个机制由源自循环分支语义的共享符号结构统一起来，该结构引导LLM生成什么内容、候选如何组合以及精炼指向何处。 我们在316个线性算术、50个非线性算术和54个多阶段基准上评估CLOVER。 CLOVER解决了54个多阶段基准中的35个，比最佳基于LLM的基线（29个）高出20.7%，比最佳传统方法（22个）高出59.1%。 在线性/非线性基准上，CLOVER仍具竞争力，总体解决了366个程序中的355个。
